description: Run a read-only SQL SELECT against the USDA-NRCS Soil Data Access database (SSURGO) — the full US soil survey schema: legend, mapunit, component, chorizon, cointerp, plus the SDA_ spatial helper functions such as SDA_Get_Mukey_from_intersection_with_WktWgs84. Use for anything the point and component tools do not cover: soil series by county, prime farmland acreage, drainage class distributions, crop yield indices. Keyless.

examples.sql: SELECT TOP 5 m.muname, m.muacres FROM mapunit m INNER JOIN legend l ON l.lkey = m.lkey WHERE l.areasymbol = 'IA153' ORDER BY m.muacres DESC

sql.description: A T-SQL SELECT, e.g. "SELECT TOP 10 m.muname, m.muacres FROM mapunit m INNER JOIN legend l ON l.lkey = m.lkey WHERE l.areasymbol = 'IA153' ORDER BY m.muacres DESC". SELECT only. Use TOP n rather than LIMIT — this is SQL Server.
